description: If PA proves uniform totality and uniqueness of an arithmetic graph, adjoining its function symbol and all expanded-language induction instances is conservative for sentences of the original arithmetic language.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.graph_extension_conservative {n : ℕ}
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (hφ :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.totalUnique φ))
  (σ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence)
  (hσ :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.graphExtension φ)
      ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.extensionMap n).onSentence σ)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA σ
